subject: Draft MAP + reprioritized milestones after procurement delay
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Draft MAP + next steps (attached)

Tom — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the StellarNet POC that captures what we discussed: milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close window. High-level items below: 

- Milestone 1 (Week 1–2): Technical kick-off + environment access — Owner: StellarNet (Anna) / Redwood SE (Dev) — Dependency: VPN access and SSO test account
- Milestone 2 (Week 2–4): Model evaluation + performance baseline — Owner: Redwood (Dev) — Dependency: dataset subset and QoS targets from StellarNet
- Milestone 3 (Week 4–6): Integration validation + security checklist — Owner: StellarNet Security / Redwood CS (Vanessa) — Dependency: evidence for SOC2 controls and network whitelisting
- Milestone 4 (Week 6–8): Exec review & procurement signoff — Owner: StellarNet Procurement / Redwood Sales (Evelyn)

Target close: end of Q2 (tentative)
Action items for you: please confirm the VPN/SSO contact and the internal target procurement date so we can lock milestones. I attached: StellarNet_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx and our SOW template for reference.

Next steps (proposed):
- You: confirm procurement timeline and procurement contact (Anna?) — by Thu, 03 Mar
- We (Dev): prepare performance runbook and sample results — by Fri, 10 Mar
- We (Vanessa): draft onboarding checklist and initial project timeline — by Mon, 13 Mar

If those look good, I'll circulate a revised XLSX and pull the MAP into HubSpot so we have shared visibility.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0162

Attachments: StellarNet_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx; SOW_template_redwood.pdf

From: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@stellarnet.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Liu <anna.liu@stellarnet.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP + next steps (attached)

Thanks, Evelyn — appreciate the clear plan and the workbook. Couple of updates from our side: 

- Procurement just flagged that our vendor review cycle will shift by ~6 weeks due to a board-level vendor consolidation review. That pushes our earliest signoff to late June.
- Our security team also asked for additional SOC 2 evidence and a short network diagram to satisfy the third-party vendor assessment. I'll loop Anna (cc'd) who is owning procurement and security intake.

Given that shift, can we do two things on the MAP:
1) Rebaseline the final signoff target to 2027-06-30 (StellarNet internal target)
2) Reprioritize the MAP so that security evidence and the network diagram are delivered earlier (within Week 2) so our security review can run in parallel with procurement.

I can share our procurement checklist if that helps map dependencies.

—Tom
Tom Reeves
Director, IT Procurement | StellarNet Inc.
t.reeves@stellarnet.com | (617) 555-0833

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP + next steps (attached)

On Wed, Mar 2, 2027 at 09:42 AM Tom Reeves <t.reeves@stellarnet.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Evelyn — appreciate the clear plan and the workbook. Couple of updates from our side:
> - Procurement just flagged that our vendor review cycle will shift by ~6 weeks due to a board-level vendor consolidation review. That pushes our earliest signoff to late June.
> - Our security team also asked for additional SOC 2 evidence and a short network diagram to satisfy the third-party vendor assessment. I'll loop Anna (cc'd) who is owning procurement and security intake.

Thanks Tom — noted. We've sketched a quick rebaseline and a proposal below; I'll take the lead on the technical deliveries. Proposed changes to the MAP: 

- New target close: 2027-06-30 (per StellarNet request)
- Move "Security evidence (SOC2 summary + network diagram)" to Week 1 (deliverable: SOC2 extract + diagram) — Owner: Redwood (Dev) — Due: Fri, 05 Mar 2027
- Keep performance baseline in Week 2–3 but make it non-blocking for procurement (deliver sample reports) — Owner: Redwood (Dev) — Due: Fri, 12 Mar 2027
- Integration validation after security okays network (Week 3–5) — Owner: StellarNet / Redwood CS (Vanessa)
- Procurement signoff moved to Week 12 with weekly syncs starting Tue, 09 Mar 2027 (30-min check-ins)

I attached an updated MAP workbook draft (same filename: StellarNet_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) in the drive link and will push the updated version to the HubSpot MAP record (HS-20482). Vanessa — can you own the onboarding checklist and confirm whether we should also prepare a short runbook for their security team? Karthik — can you review the SOW template for any procurement-specific clauses before I send to Tom's team?

I'll update HubSpot once we confirm owners.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: (referenced in drive) StellarNet_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx

From: Tom Reeves <t.reeves@stellarnet.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Liu <anna.liu@stellarnet.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Draft MAP + next steps (attached)

Evelyn/Dev — this looks good. We accept the reprioritized milestones and the revised target close of 2027-06-30. Anna will send the procurement checklist by end of day and our security reviewer (cc'd) will confirm if the SOC2 extract + diagram suffice.

Confirming weekly 30-min syncs starting Tue, 09 Mar 2027 at 10:00 AM PT — I've accepted the calendar invite. Please send the SOC2 extract and network diagram by Fri, 05 Mar so our security team can kick off the review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here — looking forward to the MAP updates in HubSpot.

—Tom
